what: With the mouse over the panel (from 2 seconds after opening), a 170px gray disc grows from 0 at the cursor over .5s (.12s late, cubic-bezier(.6,.1,.11,1)) and floats up together with the text “Click to Enter”. Inside the disc a white disc fills over .5s while the text grows over .3s. The disc follows the cursor by 15% of the remaining distance per frame and is blended with difference, so it becomes a black disc on a light background and a green-tinged disc over pink. Leaving the panel or pressing shrinks it away along the same curve, and after pressing it doesn’t show again (entered). While the disc is up, fx-disc-on is added to html

options.ready: Time after opening when the circle starts to appear (sec), default 2
options.once: When true (default), it does not show again after one press and leaves fx-disc-entered and an fx:enter event on the board. When false it always shows
options.text: Text inside the circle, default Click to Enter — [data-fx-part=label] If a child exists, its text
options.--fx-disc: Circle background (css), default gray toward var(--kf-ink) — blended via difference

note: Nothing is attached without a mouse (hover) — on phones a different hint such as ”Tap to Enter” sits at the screen center. One circle is attached at the end of body and removed on release

from.where: index.html hero Click to Enter (original .hd-cursor-enter — 170px, opacity .3s .1s · transform .5s .12s cubic-bezier(.6,.1,.11,1), inner white circle .5s, text .3s .1s, follow .15, from 2 seconds in)
